Rae S.: Postmortem follow-up from the 03/18 tail event. Need to assign owners for remediation, and decide the SLO handling for the next 2 weeks.
Diego M.: Ill take the runtime side (per-shard KV eviction tuning + hotspot metrics). ETA 72h for a staged rollout + perf job.
Hannah K.: Ill own autoscaler/alerts and dashboard updates. Plan: add a short burst counter, reduce scale-up cooldown to 20s, and surface a "shadow SLO" tile for ops. ETA 48h.
Rae S.: Suggest we do NOT alter the public SLO. Instead use a short-lived internal "shadow SLO" at 280ms for ops calculations and error-budget shielding; mark the public SLO dashboard with an incident annotation for transparency.
Diego M.: Shadow SLO works for me. Ill also annotate traces and add shard-level metrics so we can verify hotspot fixes.
Hannah K.: Draft alert for staging (ops only):
```
alert: ShadowP95Exceeded
expr: service:inference_p95_ms > 280
for: 5m
labels: {severity: "page"}
annotations: {runbook: "https://go/redwood/runbooks/kv-hotspot"}
```
Ill push to staging dashboard and leave public alerts untouched.
OpsBot: Incident 2026-03-18 | estimated error-budget impact: 4.2% | current p95: 312ms | runbook: https://go/redwood/incident/2026-0318
Rae S.: Owners & ETAs: Diego -> runtime PR + perf (3d), Hannah -> autoscale + shadow SLO tile + staging alert (2d), Rae -> canary plan + rollback criteria (1d). Add ETAs to PM ticket and tag @oncall for rollout window.
Diego M.: PR draft: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/1812 - includes eviction tweak and hotspot metrics. Running perf now.
Hannah K.: Infra PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/1203 - adds burst counter + cooldown change. Staging tile: https://dash.redwood/s/ops/shadow-slo. Canary ready after runtime merges.
Rae S.: Canary checklist before rollout: (1) update internal SLO docs and flag public dashboard, (2) canary traffic = 5%, (3) rollback if p95 > 350ms for 10m OR error-rate delta > 0.5%. Any objections?
Diego M.: No objections. Perf run shows ~16% p95 improvement on synthetic load. Will finalize patch tomorrow morning.
Hannah K.: Scheduling 11:00 UTC canary. Ill notify CS for the public dashboard note and attach the incident annotation.
Rae S.: Thanks. After canary well decide whether to keep the shadow SLO for the 14-day window or restore normal ops math. Logging follow-ups in the postmortem ticket now. :thumbsup:
